📜 Basics

Expert system

In simple words

An early kind of AI that makes decisions by following many if-then rules written down by human experts.

An early kind of AI that answers questions in one narrow field by following a large set of “if …, then …” rules collected from human experts. Expert systems were a big part of AI in the 1970s and 1980s. Most of them couldn't learn: every rule had to be written by hand.

Example. A car-repair expert system might ask: “Does the engine turn over?” If it doesn't and the lights are dim, it suggests checking the battery.
